exposure: Engagement in informal human milk sharing (donor vs. recipient status)
cohort: The cohort consists of individuals acting as donors or recipients in informal human milk sharing networks in Ireland.
finding: Recipients of informal human milk sharing reported significantly higher rates of cesarean sections, birth complications, and traumatic births compared to donors, with postpartum anxiety prevalent in both groups, while motivations for engagement varied.
mod_finding: Recipients of informal human milk sharing reported significantly higher rates of cesarean sections compared to donors.
cross-section timing: Conducted at a single point in time, gathering retrospective information on birth experiences and current practices related to informal human milk sharing.
